dialogues.speaker: Rytova
dialogues.text: Wrong steps! Let me demonstrate again!

dialogues.speaker: Rytova
dialogues.text: #Ah! Hello, {NICKNAME}. I’ve been practicing the whole time. I haven't been slacking off at all.

dialogues.speaker: Rytova
dialogues.text: The next time Odette comes to check on me, I'll definitely dance even better!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I won't interrupt your practice, then.

dialogues.speaker: Rytova
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll get back to teaching everyone the dance soon, too. Whew... Let's see, the next sequence is...

dialogues.speaker: Rytova
dialogues.text: I know. Odette told me that overtraining can tire out the body and make my moves less precise in later practices.

dialogues.speaker: Rytova
dialogues.text: So, hard training and enough rest are equally important! And so are a balanced diet and sound sleep!

dialogues.speaker: Rytova
dialogues.text: She even made me a diet plan. She said it was her healthy plan, and that if I followed it, I'd eat well and feel full.

dialogues.speaker: Rytova
dialogues.text: But... some of the dishes look just like weeds by the roadside. Can they really fill me up...?

dialogues.speaker: Rytova
dialogues.text: ...Maybe it wouldn't hurt if I snuck a tiny piece of cake, right...?
